name: 三界神话v2.578b版
group_note: 三界神话「测试二区」(San Jie Shen Hua, test-zone-2 edition), third of the 5-lib sjsh family cluster; this variant's sited.lpc already unconditionally allows loopback connections (no wizard-only gate), unlike sjshv150. WASM pass fixed: (1) §7.60 master.lpc log_error()/standard_trace() -> CHANNEL_D mid-compile crash, guarded both with find_object(CHANNEL_D). (2) A new §7.61-adjacent bug once fix (1) let CHANNEL_D actually load: channeld.lpc's do_channel() unconditionally calls environment(me)->query("no_chat") without checking environment(me) is non-null -- crashes with 'Bad argument 1 to EFUN call_other()' whenever do_channel() is invoked on an environment-less object (e.g. master.lpc's this_object(), via log_error()'s own CHANNEL_D broadcast of a caught connect() error) -- added an environment(me) truthiness guard. (3) §7.61 message() simul_efun wrapper missing exclude||({}) guard, same as sjshv150. (4) §7.41-class corrupted emoted.o, same catch(restore()) fix. (5) §8.1-class is_chinese() byte-range bug in BOTH adm/daemons/chinesed.lpc (the real implementation CHINESE_D delegates to) and check_legal_name()'s i%2 parity gate in logind.lpc (same UTF8-vs-GBK-byte-pairing mismatch as sjshv150) -- fixed both to codepoint-range/per-character checks. No convertd.lpc in this snapshot (file doesn't exist). Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist. Verified: full registration (new->id->admin-password->confirm->regular-password->confirm->name->email->gender) progresses cleanly through every step with zero unexpected errors; default_trusted_write ACL directly source-verified to grant (admin) unrestricted '/' access (exact permission-display confirmation was not captured in the scripted test due to timing/flood variance already documented as a known non-blocking harness limitation on sibling libs in this family). LPC formatter run across all 12494 files; reverted 3 files with confirmed CJK re-spacing corruption (2 shared with sjsh/sjshv150 plus one duplicate copy) found via the same-text-despaced-matches-old-file scan across 138 formatter-touched files; also directly diff-reviewed both map.lpc files present -- clean, cosmetic only. Post-formatter re-verified clean.
